Turbochargers for compression-ignition engines fall under HTS 8414.59 (other fans/blowers) or 8414.80 (compressors)? Per CBP rulings, turbochargers are classified in 8414.80. Specifically, 8414.80.16 covers turbochargers and superchargers: "Turbochargers and supercharges, intake air compressors for internal combustion engines" — the sub-breakdown is 8414.80.16 (Turbocompressors: single-stage, other: operating at gauge pressure not exceeding 11.74 kPa?), 8414.80.17 (multistage), 8414.80.20 (other turbocompressors), etc.

Recalled structure:
- 8414.80.05: Turbocharger and supercharger, for engines... Actually 8414.80.05 is "Turbocharger and supercharger..., of a kind used with ... gas turbines"? I recall 8414.80.1605 "Turbocompressors, single stage, other: Not exceeding 22.4 kW? " and 8414.80.2000 "Other turbocompressors". CBP rulings on turbochargers: "classified in 8414.80.1605, HTSUS, which provides for 'Air or vacuum pumps, air or other gas compressors...: Other: Compressors: Turbocompressors: Single stage: Other: Other: Other: Exceeding 22.4 kW?" Hmm. I recall rulings: "8414.80.1690 Other" for turbochargers not exceeding 35 psi? Indeed, the 35 psi mention hints at the subheading: 8414.80.16 "Compressors... Single stage, Other: Other 'Other'"; 8414.80.05 is "Compressors capable of pressure exceeding 3 bar (about 43.5 psi)?" Actually 8414.80.05 is "Turbocharger and supercharger... " Hmm. I recall 8414.80.1605 "Other: Not exceeding 35 psi? " The 35 psi threshold fits 8414.80.16 "Other: Single stage: Other: Other: Operating at pressure not exceeding 35 psi?" I'll go with 8414.80.1690? I'll pick 8414.80.1690.
